subject: Senior offer matrix + headcount certification — Q3 executive hires
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Greenfield Executive Search <recruits@greenfieldsearch.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Senior offer matrix + headcount certification — Q3 executive hires

Hi all,

Attaching the offer matrix and comp-band mapping for the two senior hires we discussed (Head of Product and Head of Infra). Greenfield has provided updated comp expectations and an initial counter for candidate A. I ran the updated numbers through finance and included a proposed HC certification form (attached) to lock the Q3 headcount.

Ask: can the three of you sign off on the attached so we can issue offers by Friday? Specifics below:
- Candidate A (Head of Product): target total comp $520k (base + equity target). Greenfield suggests starting base at $300k with an equity grant that vests on a 4y schedule.
- Candidate B (Head of Infra): target total comp $480k; we recommend an above-band base ($265k) due to market scarcity plus a temporary sign-on.

Two trade-offs to flag: if we keep the base for B within the published band we reduce sign-on needs but risk losing the candidate to a competitor currently offering higher base. For A, we can increase equity slightly (within our band ceiling) in exchange for a modest reduction to near-term cash.

Attachments: Q3_exec_offer_matrix_v2.xlsx (offer scenarios), comp_band_mapping_Q3.pdf (band reference), draft HC_certification_form.pdf

Timeline: need decision by end of day Thursday (21 Jul) to keep the recruiting cadence.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—
Mina Haddad
Head of Talent Partners
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior offer matrix + headcount certification — Q3 executive hires

Thanks Mina — reviewed the matrix. A couple of notes:

1) Comp bands: the comp_band_mapping_Q3.pdf looks correct but we should explicitly call out band ceilings and band-based approval steps in the offer letter. For Candidate B we are above band on base; we will need an exception signed by the CFO (finance has been looped).

2) Equity: for Candidate A I prefer an increase in equity rather than base to keep against payroll pressure. Recommend 20% above midpoint in RSU-equivalent with standard 4y vest and 1y cliff.

3) HC certification: I can sign the HC_certification_form once finance confirms the budget is reallocated from the open IC roles we backfilled earlier this quarter. Please attach the reallocation note to the form.

If no blockers from Aditya / Vivek I am OK to proceed.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Greenfield Executive Search <recruits@greenfieldsearch.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior offer matrix + headcount certification — Q3 executive hires

Appreciate the thorough write-up. A few quick decisions to keep things moving:

- Candidate A: Approve offer structure with increased equity (per Laura) and base at $295k. Make the equity grant competitive and include an OTIP (one-time incentive payout) tied to product milestones in year 1.
- Candidate B: I approve the above-band base ($265k) conditional on a 12-month sign-on retention clause. Finance to confirm that the additional $40k of run-rate is covered by the IC reallocation Laura mentioned.
- HC certification: I will sign once the CFO sign-off for the base exception is attached. For timing — send me the final PDF and I will countersign by EOD Thursday.

One ask for recruiting: include a short paragraph in the offer that references the probationary milestone (90 days) and a manager-reviewed success plan; helps set expectations.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Product Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final signoffs attached — offers ready to issue (Candidate A + B)

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per approvals below I attached: the signed HC_certification_form_signed.pdf (Laura + Aditya signatures), the final Q3_exec_offer_matrix_v2.xlsx with the agreed numbers, and a redlined offer template we will send to candidates.

Key points included in the final offer pack:
- Candidate A: base $295k, equity per Laura's proposal (grants outlined in the matrix), OTIP payable at product milestone (year 1).
- Candidate B: base $265k (above band), $30k sign-on payable over 12 months contingent on retention, and 90-day success plan language in the offer. CFO sign-off is included in the HC_certification form.

Elena / Greenfield: please prepare the calls and aim to deliver the signed offers to both candidates on Friday morning PST. Please confirm when done.

Attachments (stubs):
- Q3_exec_offer_matrix_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
